topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I held the package, its weight a stark reminder of the mistake. The address, mine now, yet it belonged not to me. I considered what to do, the right path muddled. Opening it seemed wrong, a breach of unseen trust. Sending it back, though, what of the item's value, its importance to the rightful owner? I traced the edges, feeling the weight of an unknown cargo, a responsibility not mine. Yet, the longer it sat, the heavier it grew, pressing down with the weight of a choice I couldn’t quite make.
